findings.summary: The /ai Route is not wrapped in <FeatureFlipper feature="AI_APPLICANT_SUMMARY"> -- the tab is accessible via direct URL even when the flag is off
findings.spec_requirement: Spec section 4 (line 128): 'Wrap the new route in <FeatureFlipper feature="AI_APPLICANT_SUMMARY">.' Spec constraint (line 204): 'the /ai route must redirect to /overview' when the feature is disabled.
findings.actual_behavior: The <Route path={`${match.path}/ai`}> at lines 278-287 renders PlatoTab unconditionally. Inside the <Switch>, React Router matches the first child Route whose path matches, so a direct visit to /ai will match this Route and render PlatoTab before {redirector()} is evaluated. The conditional possiblePaths array (line 155) prevents the redirector from navigating TO /ai, but does not prevent the Route from matching when the user is already ON /ai. Any user who types or bookmarks the /ai URL can view PlatoTab with the flag off.
findings.fix: Wrap the Route in <FeatureFlipper feature="AI_APPLICANT_SUMMARY">: `<FeatureFlipper feature="AI_APPLICANT_SUMMARY"><Route path={...} render={...} /></FeatureFlipper>`. This also requires importing the FeatureFlipper component (see H2).

findings.summary: FeatureFlipper component not imported -- spec requires all three named imports
findings.spec_requirement: Spec section 4 (line 126): 'Import FeatureFlipper, useFeatureFlipper, and Features from @ats/src/components/shared/FeatureFlipper'.
findings.actual_behavior: Line 18 imports only `{ useFeatureFlipper, Features }`. The `FeatureFlipper` component (the JSX wrapper used as `<FeatureFlipper feature="...">`) is not imported. This is a direct consequence of H1 -- the import was omitted because the wrapper was omitted.
findings.fix: Change the import to `import { FeatureFlipper, useFeatureFlipper, Features } from "@ats/src/components/shared/FeatureFlipper";`.
